tokens.name: lemon
tokens.usage: Brand yellow. The site header, the current-step marker, highlight fills and the one bright moment on a screen. Put ink on it, never white. Also the exact ground of the yellow-background mascot PNG.

tokens.name: lemon-soft
tokens.usage: Large yellow areas: task cards, tips, the 'Your task' prompt in every lesson stage. ink and ink-muted text read on it.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Brand lavender. The home welcome panel, support buttons (word help, simpler English), learner tiles, badges. ink and ink-muted text only; ink-soft, correct and retry fail on it.

tokens.name: lavender-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of support (lavender) buttons.

tokens.name: lavender-soft
tokens.usage: Selected states (a chosen answer, the active tab), secondary panels, the Culture section tint's lighter partner.

tokens.name: lavender-wash
tokens.usage: Quiet tinted surfaces: the learning-goal strip, definition popovers, the 'On my own' speaking card.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Links, glossary-term text and underline, the focus ring. Reads on paper, canvas, lemon, lemon-soft, lavender-soft and lavender-wash (6.9:1 or more) and on lavender (5.2:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every ground. Also the fill of primary buttons, the active navigation pill, and the frame around the home page.

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of primary (ink) buttons.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (primary buttons, the active step).

tokens.name: on-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on an ink fill (the sub-line of the current step). 16.1:1 on ink.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: guiding questions, metadata, helper lines. Reads on every ground in this list, lavender included (5.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on paper and canvas only (6.4:1, 5.9:1): placeholders, timestamps. Never on lavender.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Cards, reading panels, inputs, the home hero. The white-background mascot PNG belongs on it.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards on course, dashboard, journal and educator pages. A light grey with a faint violet bias, dark enough that white cards stand out on cheap screens.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: The near-black frame and gutters of the home page, an alias of ink.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders and dividers (1.5:1 on paper, so cards stay visible in bright rooms). Carries no meaning on its own.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: text fields, unselected answer options, outline buttons, on paper and canvas (3.6:1, 3.3:1). On lavender use ink-muted instead.

tokens.name: correct
tokens.usage: Correct-answer text and icon, always with a check mark and the word 'Correct'. Teal, not green, so it stays apart from retry for colour-blind learners. On paper, canvas and correct-soft.

tokens.name: correct-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a correct answer and its feedback note.

tokens.name: retry
tokens.usage: 'Not quite yet' text and icon, always with the retry arrow and words. Burnt orange, never red: a wrong answer is a step, not a failure. On paper, canvas and retry-soft.

tokens.name: retry-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a not-quite answer and its feedback note.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Fill of a disabled button. Its label uses ink-soft, and a helper line under it says what unlocks it.

tokens.name: sec-history
tokens.usage: Section 1, History & Human Stories: section header band, lesson-number disc, quiz intro. Always paired with its icon and name.

tokens.name: sec-history-ink
tokens.usage: Icons and small labels on sec-history, paper or canvas (6.7:1 or more).

tokens.name: sec-geography
tokens.usage: Section 2, Geography & Our Environment: header band, number disc, quiz intro.

tokens.name: sec-geography-ink
tokens.usage: Icons and small labels on sec-geography, paper or canvas (5.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: sec-culture
tokens.usage: Section 3, Culture, Society & Identity: header band, number disc, quiz intro. Rose, so it never reads as the brand lavender.

tokens.name: sec-culture-ink
tokens.usage: Icons and small labels on sec-culture, paper or canvas (6.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: sec-civics
tokens.usage: Section 4, Civics, Media & Everyday Economics: header band, number disc, quiz intro.

tokens.name: sec-civics-ink
tokens.usage: Icons and small labels on sec-civics, paper or canvas (6.5:1 or more).

families.body: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", Verdana, system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Funnel Display, from the same family as the original site's Funnel Sans. Headings only; never for reading passages.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The home hero line only. On phones, 52px.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Lesson-complete and quiz-result headlines. On phones, 40px.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: Why do people build towns near rivers?
styles.usage: One per page: page titles and lesson titles. On phones, 30px/34px.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings, card titles on the dashboard.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Reading-part headings, lesson rows, question prompts.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next: drawn so that similar letters (I l 1, O 0, b d) are easy to tell apart, for young readers still learning English. Nothing smaller than 14px.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: A river can make life easier for a community.
styles.usage: Lesson reading passages. Keep lines under 68 characters.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Choose one location for a new town.
styles.usage: Task prompts, questions, answer options, learner-facing paragraphs.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your writing stays on this device.
styles.usage: UI copy, card descriptions, educator pages.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, helper text, captions. The smallest size on the site.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above a card title. At most one per card.

groups.name: Wordmark
groups.note: Eczar belongs to the logo only.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The word 'Thinkerwell' beside the mascot in the header and footer. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps inside small badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control; icon-to-text in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, between answer options.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone page gutter; card padding on phones; gap between related cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on tablet.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on laptop; gap between cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page regions; tablet page gutter.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Laptop page gutter; space under a page title.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between major sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small thumbnails, letter discs' outer ring gap.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, answer options.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Question cards, evidence cards, lesson rows.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Page panels and section cards; the header's bottom corners.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The two big home panels and the lesson-complete card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, stage steps, navigation pills, toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Only for things that float over the page: definition popovers, the learner switcher, menus. Cards use borders, never shadows.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target for anything a learner presses.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of the main lesson action button and home call to action.

tokens.name: reading-measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a reading column.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of every page's column (header, pages, footer). Wide enough that a laptop's screen is used, with reading text still held to reading-measure.
